title: E-Bow Ambient Modal Bed
purpose: Leave sustained harmonic and register space for E-Bow activation, long-note intonation, drones, string changes, swells, and counter-melodies.
feel: slow spacious ambient rock with long harmonic windows

tracks.name: Drums
tracks.instrument_intent: minimal pulse only; keep cymbal and fill density low so E-Bow attacks and decay remain audible

tracks.name: Bass
tracks.instrument_intent: round sustained-support bass; avoid melodic fills in the E-Bow register

tracks.name: Pad
tracks.instrument_intent: soft long pad voicings with enough upper-register space for sustained guitar lines

provenance.notes: Original diatonic ambient practice bed designed for sustained guitar rather than song emulation.
